fields.label: Sub Route
fields.description: Second URL segment; also the section title of the route in the API docs.

fields.label: Sub Category
fields.description: Optional third URL segment and sub-folder in the API docs. Empty: the route is <base_path>/<sub_route>.

fields.label: Path
fields.description: Optional extra segments after the Sub Category, e.g. daily or by-agent/summary. Letters, digits, '.', '_', '~', '-' and '/'.

fields.label: Route
fields.description: Public path that masks the Frappe call: <base_path>/<sub_route>/<sub_category>[/<path>]. GET answers it and /{name}; POST the path; PATCH and DELETE /{name}.

fields.label: Exposed
fields.description: Set on save: the DocType passes the exposure rules, so the route is served and listed in the API docs.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Shown in the API docs under the operation names.

fields.label: Create Response
fields.description: What a POST answers: the whole new record, or only its ID (under its public name, e.g. campaign_id). Both send its URL in the Location header.

fields.label: API Names
fields.description: How this route is called in the API docs. Filled with defaults on save; edit them to hide internal names.

fields.label: Public Name
fields.description: Name of the resource in the docs instead of the DocType, e.g. Call Record. Also names its schema.
